tokens.split: first half of sequences train, second half held-out

gate_basis.kind: cubic B-spline on train-standardized z, interior knots at pooled train quantiles
gate_basis.gate2d: additive f1(z1) + f2(z2), block penalty, one REML lambda
gate_basis.z1: mean gate pre-activation over the group
gate_basis.z2: mean gate s(g) over the group

unit_gate_oracle_fit: numpy stand-in: REML ridge (unpenalized intercept) of q on the group's unit gates
